prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Checklist Layout: Redesign the choose_path screen into a structured checklist layout to clarify available options and streamline companion selection.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "checklist"}}
1: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Two Column Layout Redesign: Redesign the pick_friend screen using a two-column layout to display pet attributes and visual previews side-by-side.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "two_column"}}
2: [home, redesign] Waiting Screen Split Layout Redesign: Redesign the waiting screen into a split layout that separates pet creation progress from essential desktop placement instructions.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "split"}}
3: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Spotlight Controls Redesign: Redesign home_intro using a spotlight layout that highlights how to interact, hide, and summon the companion desktop pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "spotlight"}}
4: [sign_in, copy] Sign In Cloud Save Assurance Copy: Update sign-in headline and body to reassure users that signing in securely backs up their desktop pet and prevents loss.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Secure Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Sign in to safely back up your pet and ensure your progress and settings are never lost."}}
5: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Technical Specs Hint: Add a hint on upload_photos specifying supported image dimensions and clear lighting recommendations.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "For best results, use well-lit PNG or JPG photos with clear subject contrast."}}
6: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Status Notification: Enable desktop readiness notifications and display estimated generation remaining time on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "notify_when_ready": true}}
7: [finish, copy] Desktop Quick Controls Guidance Copy: Add concise instructions in the home_intro body explaining how to minimize, call, and open settings for the desktop pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "body": "Click your pet to interact, right-click for settings, or drag to move around your screen.", "hint": "Press hotkeys or right-click anytime to hide or call your pet back."}}
8: [choose_path, hint] Choose Path Flexible Selection Hint: Add a hint clarifying that chosen companion preferences can be changed anytime later in desktop app settings.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "Don't worry—you can adjust your path and companion settings anytime after setup."}}
9: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Sound Alert Component: Add a sound effect component to the waiting screen that plays when companion preparation is complete.
   config: {"waiting": {"components": [{"type": "sound", "label": "Play completion sound", "action": "play", "style": "subtle"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the choose_path layout inside onboarding is permitted and retains the core screen functions.
Redesigning the pick_friend screen layout inside onboarding is allowed and preserves pet selection.
Redesigning the waiting screen layout is allowed as long as pet creation progress remains visible.
Redesigning home_intro layout is allowed as home_intro is part of the onboarding flow.
Updating sign-in copy to explain cloud backup benefits is allowed and contains no forbidden dark patterns or pricing text.
Adding a technical spec hint on photo upload is a valid onboarding copy enhancement.
Displaying a real wait time estimate and readiness notification on the waiting screen is permitted.
Adding guidance copy to home_intro is allowed and explains desktop pet controls clearly.
Adding a helpful hint to choose_path is permitted and does not violate pricing or fair design rules.
Adding a completion sound component to the waiting screen is allowed inside onboarding.
